meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Dhanbari Collegiate Model School collects, uses, and protects personal information submitted through this website.

header.title: Privacy Policy
header.intro: This policy explains what information Dhanbari Collegiate Model School collects through this website, why we collect it, and what we do with it. It covers the website and the online admission form.

sections.title: Scope of this policy
paragraphs: This policy covers personal information collected through the DCMS website, including the online admission application, the notice board, the gallery, and the alumni forum. It does not cover third-party websites that we link to.
bullets: Information you submit directly, such as an admission application or a message to the alumni forum.
Information collected automatically when you visit the site, such as your IP address and browser type.
Information a parent or guardian submits on behalf of a student.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your information
paragraphs: Dhanbari Collegiate Model School is the organisation responsible for the personal information described in this policy. We hold admission records, student records, and website enquiries, and we handle all requests about them.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: What we hold depends on how you interact with the site. We ask only for information we need for a stated purpose, and we tell you what that purpose is.
bullets: Student details: name, date of birth, gender, class applied for, and a photograph.
Guardian details: name, relationship to the student, phone number, email address, and address.
Admission details: previous school, academic records, and the payment or receipt information needed to process the application.
Anything you write in a message, forum post, or comment.
Collected automatically: your IP address, browser type, operating system, and the pages you visit.
Your language preference, stored in a cookie.

sections.title: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use personal information for these purposes:
bullets: Processing admission applications, publishing acceptance lists, and collecting fees.
Creating and maintaining student and guardian records for day-to-day school operations.
Sending information about classes, exams, results, fees, and school events.
Publishing notices and announcements on the website.
Responding to messages and moderating forum posts.
Keeping the website secure and understanding how it is used, so we can improve it.
Meeting the record-keeping requirements of the education authorities.

sections.title: Why we are allowed to use it
paragraphs: Where the law requires a reason before personal information can be used, our reasons are:
bullets: Consent, for example when a guardian agrees to a student's photograph appearing in the gallery.
Carrying out the admission process you asked for.
A legal duty, for example keeping admission and attendance records as the education regulations require.
Our legitimate interests, such as operating and securing the website, provided those interests do not override your rights.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We do not sell personal information. We share it only where it is necessary to run the school or to meet a legal duty.
bullets: School staff, including teachers and the admissions office, where they need it to do their work.
Parents and guardians, and where relevant the other parent or guardian of the student.
Education authorities and examination boards, where records must be submitted by law.
Service providers who host the website, deliver email, and process payments, acting on our instructions and only for that purpose.
Law enforcement or other authorities, when we are legally required to disclose information.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Admission and student records are kept while the student is enrolled, and afterwards for the period the education regulations require. Photographs and gallery entries are removed when they are no longer relevant, or on request from a guardian.

Enquiries that do not lead to an application are kept only as long as they are needed to deal with them. Forum posts stay visible until a moderator removes them or you ask us to remove yours. When we no longer need information, we delete it or make it anonymous so that it can no longer identify anyone.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: This website uses a small number of cookies. We do not use advertising cookies, and we do not sell data to third-party advertisers.
bullets: Essential cookies keep your session and language choice working. The site will not function properly without them.
Preference cookies remember settings such as your chosen language and theme.
Analytics cookies give us aggregate counts of visits and pages viewed. We use these to understand which parts of the site are useful, not to identify you.
You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings, though blocking essential cookies may stop parts of the site from working.

sections.title: How we protect your information
paragraphs: Access to student and guardian records is limited to staff who need it for their work. The website is served over encrypted connections, backups are kept, and we limit the information we store in the first place.

sections.title: Children's privacy
paragraphs: Most of the people this site holds information about are students, and many of them are under 18. We collect a student's information from a parent or guardian, or with the guardian's consent, and we do not ask a child to submit it directly.
bullets: A guardian is responsible for the information they submit for a student.
If a guardian asks us to remove a student's photograph or personal information from the site, we will do so.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the data protection rules that apply to us, you have the right to:
Write to the school office to make any of these requests. We may need to confirm your identity before we can act, and we aim to reply within 30 days.
bullets: Ask what information we hold about you or your child, and receive a copy.
Ask us to correct information that is wrong or incomplete.
Ask us to delete information we no longer have a reason to keep.
Withdraw consent you gave us, for example for a photograph, without affecting anything we did before that.
Object to how we are using your information.
Complain to the relevant data protection authority if you believe we have handled your information improperly.

sections.title: Third-party links
paragraphs: The site may link to websites we do not control, such as examination boards or payment providers. Those websites have their own privacy practices and we are not responsible for them. Please read their policies before giving them personal information.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy when our practices or the law change. The date at the top of this page shows the current version. If a change affects information we already hold, we will tell the people concerned.

sections.title: Contact us
paragraphs: Questions, requests, and complaints about this policy can be sent to the school. You can also raise them in person at the school office.
Dhanbari Collegiate Model School, Dhanbari, Tangail
